import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 500;

    static class Input {
        long mod;
        int n, m;

        boolean read(Scanner sc) {
            if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
                n = sc.nextInt();
                m = sc.nextInt();
                mod = sc.nextLong();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        void init(Input input) {
            this.n = input.n;
            this.m = input.m;
            this.mod = input.mod;
        }
    }

    static class Data extends Input {
        long ans;

        void write() {
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    static class Solution extends Data {
        long pw(long x, long y) {
            long res = 1;
            while (y > 0) {
                if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res * x % mod;
                }
                x = x * x % mod;
                y >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        long inv(long x) {
            return pw(x, mod - 2);
        }

        long ss(int x) {
            return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
        }

        long[][] c = new long[N + 1][N + 1];

        // pair class for (long, long)
        static class Pair {
            long fs, sc;

            Pair(long fs, long sc) {
                this.fs = fs;
                this.sc = sc;
            }

            static Pair zero() {
                return new Pair(0, 0);
            }
        }

        Pair[] a = new Pair[N + 1];
        Pair[][] d = new Pair[N + 2][N + 1];

        void solve() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (i == 0 || j == 0) {
                        c[i][j] = 1;
                    } else {
                        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i][j - 1]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                a[i] = Pair.zero();
            }
            a[0] = new Pair(1, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    Pair cur;
                    long fs = a[j].fs * a[i - 1 - j].fs % mod;
                    long sc = (a[j].sc * a[i - 1 - j].fs + a[j].fs * a[i - 1 - j].sc) % mod;
                    sc = (sc * (i + 1) + (ss(j) + ss(i - 1 - j)) * fs) % mod;
                    fs = fs * (i + 1) % mod;
                    fs = fs * c[j][i - 1 - j] % mod;
                    sc = sc * c[j][i - 1 - j] % mod;
                    if (a[i] == null) {
                        a[i] = new Pair(0, 0);
                    }
                    a[i].fs = (a[i].fs + fs) % mod;
                    a[i].sc = (a[i].sc + sc) % mod;
                }
            }

            // Initialize d array
            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    d[i][j] = Pair.zero();
                }
            }
            d[0][0] = new Pair(1, 0);

            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= Math.min(n - i, m - j); k++) {
                        Pair cur;
                        long fs = a[k].fs * d[i][j].fs % mod;
                        long sc = (a[k].sc * d[i][j].fs + a[k].fs * d[i][j].sc) % mod;
                        fs = fs * c[j][k] % mod;
                        sc = sc * c[j][k] % mod;
                        int ni = i + k + 1;
                        int nj = j + k;
                        if (ni <= n + 1 && nj <= m) {
                            if (d[ni][nj] == null) {
                                d[ni][nj] = Pair.zero();
                            }
                            d[ni][nj].fs = (d[ni][nj].fs + fs) % mod;
                            d[ni][nj].sc = (d[ni][nj].sc + sc) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ans = d[n + 1][m].sc;
        }

        void clear() {
            // Reset to initial state
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                a[i] = null;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    d[i][j] = null;
                }
            }
            ans = 0;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Solution sol = new Solution();

        System.out.printf("%.20f%n", 0.0); // mimic setting precision, though not necessary in Java

        if (sc.hasNext()) {
            do {
                if (sol.read(sc)) {
                    sol.solve();
                    sol.write();
                    sol.clear();
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            } while (true);
        }

        sc.close();
    }
}
